column1: # Spanish stem-changing classes, mined from the gold oracles and
# verified by the golden harness. Exact lemmas (presentar is not
# sentar). Classes: ie (pienso; -ir verbs also raise to i when
# unstressed: sintió), ue (cuento, juego, huele; -ir raises to u:
# durmió), ei (-ir e→i everywhere stressed or raised: pido, pidió),
